description_en: Queries peripheral drivers visible to the current account, with support for filtering by ownership, brand, device type, driver ID, and keyword, and returns paginated results
description_zh: 查询当前账号可见的外设驱动，支持按归属、品牌、设备类型、驱动 ID 和关键词筛选，并分页返回结果
name: DescribePeripheralDrivers

parameters.help_en:
The driver ownership. Valid values:
WUYING: Wuying official driver.
CUSTOMER: Custom driver of the current account.

If this parameter is not specified, both types of drivers are queried
parameters.help_zh: 驱动归属。取值：WUYING，无影官方驱动；CUSTOMER，当前账号的自定义驱动。不传时查询两类驱动
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The brand identifier. Exact match is used. The value depends on the actual configuration and is not a fixed enumeration. If this parameter is not specified, drivers of all brands are returned. The example value is provided to illustrate the format only
parameters.help_zh: 品牌标识，精确匹配。按实际配置取值，无固定枚举。不传时不限制品牌。示例仅用于说明格式
parameters.name: brand

parameters.help_en: The device type identifier. Exact match is used. The value depends on the actual configuration. For example, printer indicates a printer. If this parameter is not specified, drivers of all device types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 设备类型标识，精确匹配。按实际配置取值，例如 printer 表示打印机。不传时不限制设备类型
parameters.name: device_type

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. The keyword is matched against the driver ID, brand identifier, driver name, description, device type, or brand display name. A hit on any field qualifies the driver. The wildcard % matches any number of characters, and _ matches a single character. If this parameter is not specified, no keyword filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词。匹配驱动 ID、品牌标识、驱动名称、描述、设备类型或品牌显示名称，任一字段命中即可。支持 % 匹配任意长度字符、_ 匹配单个字符。不传时不进行关键词筛选
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回条数。取值范围：1～500；默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，建议从 1 开始；默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The list of driver IDs. If this parameter is not specified or an empty array is passed in, no filtering by driver ID is applied. Only drivers that are visible to the current account and match the specified IDs are returned. IDs that do not match any driver do not produce corresponding records
parameters.help_zh: 驱动 ID 列表。不传或传入空数组时不限制驱动 ID。仅返回当前账号可见且匹配的驱动；未匹配到的 ID 不产生对应记录
parameters.name: driver_ids

parameters.help_en: Reserved parameter. This parameter does not participate in queries or pagination. Do not specify this parameter. Use PageSize to set the number of entries per page. The example value 20 is provided only to illustrate the integer type. It is not the default value of this parameter and does not take effect if specified
parameters.help_zh: 保留参数，当前不参与查询或分页，请勿传入。请使用 PageSize 设置每页返回条数。示例值 20 仅用于展示整数类型，不是该参数的默认值，也不表示传入后会生效
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Reserved parameter. Token-based pagination is not supported. Do not specify this parameter. Use PageNumber to specify the page number. The example value token-for-format-only is provided only to illustrate the string type and is not a usable pagination token
parameters.help_zh: 保留参数，当前不支持使用分页令牌查询，请勿传入。请使用 PageNumber 指定页码。示例值 token-for-format-only 仅用于展示字符串类型，不是可使用的分页令牌
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The query result. Fields not declared as required in the response model may be empty or not returned for optional and reserved fields
schema.description_zh: 查询结果。响应模型未声明字段必须返回，可选信息和保留字段可能为空或不返回

Count.description_en: The total number of matching drivers, not the length of the current page list. This value may be 0 when the current page contains no data
Count.description_zh: 匹配的驱动总数，不是当前页列表长度。当前页无数据时可能返回 0

DriverInfos.description_en: The list of driver information on the current page. An empty list is returned when no data is available
DriverInfos.description_zh: 当前页的驱动信息列表，无数据时返回空列表

items.description_en: The information about a peripheral driver

Brand.description_en: The brand to which the driver belongs

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the driver record was created, in ISO 8601 (RFC 3339) format with a time zone offset. The time zone offset is based on the returned value. This field may be empty or not returned if the time information does not exist
CreateTime.description_zh: 驱动记录创建时间，采用包含时区偏移的 ISO 8601（RFC 3339）格式。时区偏移以返回值为准。时间信息不存在时可能为空或不返回

DeviceType.description_en: The device type to which the driver applies

Icon.description_en: The brand icon URL. This field may be empty or not returned if no icon is configured. The example value is for illustration purposes only
Icon.description_zh: 品牌图标 URL。未配置图标时可能为空或不返回。示例为示意地址

Id.description_en: The driver ID, which can be used for subsequent queries
Id.description_zh: 驱动 ID，可用于后续查询

OsType.description_en: The operating system to which the driver applies, such as Windows. The actual returned value prevails
OsType.description_zh: 驱动适用的操作系统，例如 Windows。以实际返回值为准

OwnerType.description_en:
The driver ownership. Valid values:
WUYING: Wuying official driver.
CUSTOMER: Custom driver of the current account
OwnerType.description_zh: 驱动归属。取值：WUYING，无影官方驱动；CUSTOMER，当前账号的自定义驱动

Source.description_en:
The driver source. Valid values:
OpsApp: Uploaded from the management console.
WuyingHelper: Uploaded from Wuying Helper.
Wuying: Wuying source.

Unrecognized sources may also be classified as Wuying. To distinguish between official and custom drivers, use OwnerType
Source.description_zh: 驱动来源。取值：OpsApp，管理端上传；WuyingHelper，无影助手上传；Wuying，无影来源。无法识别的来源也可能归为 Wuying；区分官方与自定义驱动请使用 OwnerType

MaxResults.description_en: Reserved field. This field does not provide a valid return value and may not be returned. This operation uses PageSize and PageNumber for pagination. Do not rely on this field. The example value 20 is provided only to illustrate the integer type and does not represent the actual return value, default value, or page size of this operation
MaxResults.description_zh: 保留字段，当前未提供有效返回值，可能不返回。本接口使用 PageSize 和 PageNumber 分页，请勿依赖该字段。示例值 20 仅用于展示整数类型，不代表当前接口实际返回值、默认值或本次查询的分页大小

NextToken.description_en: Reserved field. Token-based pagination is not supported and this field may not be returned. Do not rely on this field for continued queries. The example value token-for-format-only is provided only to illustrate the string type and is not an actual return value or a usable pagination token
NextToken.description_zh: 保留字段，当前不提供基于令牌的分页能力，可能不返回。请勿依赖该字段继续查询。示例值 token-for-format-only 仅用于展示字符串类型，不是实际返回值或可使用的分页令牌

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，排查问题时可提供该值
